output.title: Spotting Phishing Emails
output.summary: A short, practical course that helps office staff recognise the common warning signs of phishing emails, check suspicious messages safely, and report them through the right channel.
output.audience: Office staff with everyday email use and no security specialism
prerequisites: Uses a work email account daily
output.riskRationale: General security awareness; no regulated or hazardous activity is taught.

assumptions.text: Learners have a reporting button or security mailbox at work.

gaps: Organisation-specific reporting channel must be configured before deployment.
outOfScope: Technical email authentication (SPF, DKIM, DMARC) configuration
